description: Fires most strongly when the centre column (col 3) holds exactly 3 stones, so the next centre drop lands on row 4 (row index 3), and the column to its left (col 2) is taller, with the opponent's stone beside that landing cell. A tall left side (cols 0-2) adds to it; stones on the right side reduce it. The mirror pattern (col 4) does not work. Weaker firing near the threshold is scattered and is not explained.
effect: None measurable: steering it to max or zero moves the move probabilities by at most about 3 points.
notes: Top bands (99.5%+) are crisp: col3 height 3 in ~90%, col2 height >=4 in 100%, (3,2) theirs ~78%. act minimal pairs agree: removing the (3,2) stone or filling (3,3) kills it, and the col-4 mirror gives ~0.1. But bands 5-6 (most of the firing) are diffuse. Best dev F1 0.391 (hand-weighted cell points, P .40 R .38, AUROC .68), sim share 0.18. Strict rule F1 0.27-0.34. May be a distributed/random direction with one strong pattern at the top. Synth 4.443 beats dev max.
